newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-ARIS BEAT BESIKTAS IN TROUBLE-FREE REPLAY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-ARIS BEAT BESIKTAS IN TROUBLE-FREE REPLAY.

text.p: Aris Salonika of Greece beat Turkey's Besiktas Istanbul 77-64 in a trouble-free Korac Cup replay on Tuesday, four weeks after the original tie disintegrated into a brawl and had to be abandoned.
The replay, staged behind closed doors on the orders of the International Basketball Federation, was dominated by the Greeks, for whom Panayotis Liadelis top-scored with 15 points.

The original match in the northern Greek city of Salonika on December 11 ended in chaos after Besiktas' American forward Gary Alexander grabbed Aris' Dinos Angelidis from behind and threw him out of the court, prompting other players to start fighting.
Police intervened to tear the two sides apart. Noone was injured.
Angelidis was suspended for three games while Alexander was banned for four. He was also arrested, charged with assault by a Greek public prosecutor and released after a trial date was set for March.
